tei:div.tei:p: (15)rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ dmar ser ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor can/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la/ btud de cung zad brjod par bya/ rgyal ba'i chos sgo ji snyed pa/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis su 'dus/ de'ang lam gyi rim pa ru/ bsdu na skyes baya gsum gyi ni/ lam gyi rim pa sa skya pa'i/ snang gsum rgyud gsum khrid kyis ston/ snying ma'i rgyal ba klong chen pas/ rnam mkhyen lam kun tshang ba'i gzhung*/ sems nyid ngal bso chen par bsdus/ bka' gdams bstan pa'i rgyan gcig pu/ mnyam med jo bo'i lam rim don/ gsal mdzad 'jam dbyangs gtsang kha bas/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa bkral/ nges 'byung byang sems lta ba gsum/ theg chen lam gyi rim pa las/ gtso dang phal pa'i khyad par gyi/ gtso bo thog chen lam 'dus lags/ zhar la spros na (16)gzhan gnyis 'dus/ theg chen dbu ma'i lta ba las/ thal rang dbye bar deng sang 'dir/ mi mthun mkhas pas rtsod par bya/ ci zer med pa'i gnas byas mdo/ mdor na kun rdzob rang mtshan gyi/ grub pa'i zhal bzhes yod med las/ thal rang gnyis su dbye ba dang*/ rang rgyud don dam lta ba dang*/ thal 'gyur dgongs pa gcig pa ru/ gsar ma'i mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed/ rang rgyud lta ba rtogs pa na/ thal 'gyur rtogs pa'i khyab mtha' 'cha'/ 'on kyang rang mtshan grub pa'i chos/ rang rgyud gzhung nas gang bstan pa/ thal 'gyur rtogs pa'i dgos pa dang*/ bcas zhes dngos sang bzhed pa lags/ dgags bya don dam khyad par gyi/ sgra sbyar ma sbyar khyad kyang zer/ tha snyad rang mtshan grub mon gyis/ thal rang khyad par 'byed kyang gsungs/ gang zag rim dang gcig char gyis/ lta ba bskyed pa'i tshul gyis ni/ khyad par 'byed ces 'ga' yang gsung*/ (17)mnyam bzhag rjes thob rtsal bton pa'i/ khyad par du ma rang blos dpag grub mtha'i dbye ba byas mod kyang*/ dgag gzhi ngos 'dzin legs par shes/ gtan tshig gnad la song gyur na/

mthar thug thal rang dgos gnad gcig 'on kyang grub mtha'i kha 'dzin gyis/ chags sdang pho rus byed byed nas/ dgag bya'i ngos 'dzin ngos ma zin/ gtan tshig phyi ltas kha shag tsam/ thal rang gnyis ka'i lam las ring*/ zhi gnas lhag mthong sgom tshul la/ mkhyon rab bdag po rje yab sras/ dang po zhi lhag so sor bsgom/ zhi gnas la yang zhi gnas tsam/ zhi gnas khyad par gnyis su 'byed/ byams pa la sogs dmigs rnam la/ dpyad dang 'jog pa'i sgom pa yi/ sems gnas tsam la zhi gnas dang*/ shin sbyangs bde ba 'dren nus pa'i/ zhi gnas khyad par yin tshes gsungs/ de nas dpyad pa'i lhag mthong bskyed/ dpyad (18)pas shinasbyangs 'dren nus su/ zhi lhag zung du 'jug par bstan/ de tshe gnas dang gsal ba'i cha/ shes pa'i rgyud la gcig 'dres pa'i/ bsgom pa de ni sbyor lam gsungs/ zhi gnas sgom pa'i rim pa las/ rgyal ba'i sku la dmigs pa'i tshul/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo sde bzhin/ bsod nams khyad par che ba'i phyir/ de nyid dmigs kyis bkar nas gsungs/ de tshe bying rgod gnyis po de/ bying bas gsal cha nang du sdud/ 'phro bas gnas pa yul la dkrog de phyir gnyis po skyon du gsungs/ bying pa phra rag gnyis su dbye/ dmigs pa yid yul ma bor kyang*/ rnam pa'i 'dzin stang zhan par gsungs/ rag pa dmigs rnams gnyis ka nyams/ dran med thom mer lus pa yin/ 'di gnyis bsgom pa'i skyon cher bstan/ 'phro ba yul la sems phyir g.yeng*/ spros dngas rag par 'dzin pa'i phyir/ yul dang sems gnyis phan tshun du/ rten dang brten pas 'brel (19)ba'i las/ 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun mi bcad/ de phyir 'di yang sgom pa'i skyon/ bying rmugs 'phrod rgod 'gyod pa rnams/ gnyis gnyis byed las gcig pas na/ bying rgod gnyis zhes bstan na yang*/ nang gses sems byung re re la/ phra rag khyad par byed par shes/ zhi gnas 'jig rten bsgom pa dang*/ lhag mthong lta bar brjod na yang*/

nam zhig dbyer med gcig gyur na/ zung du 'jug pa'i sgom zhes bya/ 'phro ba tshul min yid byed kyis/ bskyed pa'i rnam rtog log pa yin/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab de/ gnas tshul yul la zhugs pa'i blo/ yin pas de gnyis rgyud gcig la/ 'phro bar gcig kyang spang len 'thad/ des na lhag mthong bskyed pa la/ dbu ma'i rig pa'i rnam grangs 'gas/ yang yang brtags par bya ba gces/ ci yang mi bsam dmigs pa ni/ mngon rtags 'dzin pa'i sgom pa zhes/ sa bcu'i sems dpas gsal bar ru/ (20)lam min lalog pa'i rgyu ru bstan/ 'on kyang 'od gsal mi rtog pa/ 'phags pa yab sras gzhung mang du/ rim lnga'i bzhi pa 'od gsal zhes/ las rlang bslad pa bral ba yi/ gnyis snang rgyu bas ma gso shing*/ ma rmugs 'od gsal rang ngo la/ rang bzhin gsal la mi rtog pa/ 'dus pa'i lam gyi dngos gzhi yin/ dang po sems kyi 'phen pa dang*/ phyin nas lta thog bzhag pa yin/ ji bzhin mngon gyur ye shes 'di/ bsam med ha shang lta ba la/ khyad par shin tu che bar shes/ 'dus pa'i thabs kyis drang ba dang*/ rdzogs chen man ngag ngo sprod pa'i/ ye shes tsam du gcig pa las/ khyad par zhib mo btags pas go/ des na mdo sngags lam gnyis la/ sems dang ye shes lam byed pa'i/ theg pa'i khyad par 'di yin zhes/ rgyal dbang klong chen rab 'byams dang*/ mkhas pa rgyal ba gtsang kha pas/ sngags dang 'dus pa'i rim pa las/ lan gcig (21)ma yin bka' stsal ba/ de phyir gzu bor zhib mo'i blos/ brtags na som nyi'i skabs bral snyam/ de ltar ma yin deng sang 'dir/ gsar snying mkhas brun skye bo 'gas/ rang gi rgyud la mi rtogs par/ thal rang lta ba'i mtho khyad rtsod/ chags sdang me yis rang gzhan bsregs/ mdo sngags lam gyi srog rtsa bston/ dgos med rang lugs gzhan lugs dang*/ gcig lugs gnyis lugs mang po bsgrangs/ don med mi tshe stong zad byas/ thar pa'i lam la rtogs par dkon/

de phyir ma 'dres mdza' bshes la/ drangs po'i ngag gi lam nas brjod/ bdag ni thos chung blo gros zhan/ rnam g.yeng le los bcom pa la/ rang gzhan grub mtha' thos tsam byed/ nyam len rgyud la ma 'byor bas/ ha cang zab mo'i gdams pa dkon/ 'on kyang dam pa gang de'i bka'/ brtsal bas bka' nan ma lcog nas/ cung zad sa bon tsam du spros/ rgyas par phyis (22)nas zhu ba yis/ rten 'byung dge ba'i bkra shis zhu/ rin gling mchog gzigs sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i dgos sel du rnying btsun ngag dbang dpal bzang du 'bod pa'i g.yeng ba can des 'phral phul dgo'o/// /
